info.name: HTK
info.formula: shape = mean_symm + t * axis + sum_i z_i * sigma[i] * components[i]  (right half, 193 CVs)
info.axis: axis = mean_asym - mean_symm: t = 0 is the symmetric mean, t = 1 the asymmetric (ergo) mean
info.gene: full 386-CV gene (both halves) added to the mirrored shape: gene_mean + sum_i w_i * gene_sigma[i] * gene_components[i] (first eight patches; the other eight are mirror-antisymmetric), or genes/<name>.npy (NP-01, NP-01S, U2: one mouse each)
info.error_definition: per-mouse RMS of the CV Euclidean distance (mm) when that mouse is left out of the fit; median and max over mice

layout.notes: mean_symm/axis/components hold the 193 CVs of the right half (patches 0-7, X >= 0), in mm, +Y is the front. CV order inside a patch: U fastest, (grid[0]+1) x (grid[1]+1) CVs. Patch j (8..15) is patch j-8 with X negated, read in the order given by mirror_flips. centerline marks the CVs held at X = 0.
